payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-25 (offline, no provider access): the republish is TWO separate live writes, and neither can be scoped to this one record. (1) The legacy differential_records row: npm run differentials:seed -- --owner-id <owner uuid> (dry run), then --write --confirm, upserts ALL 232 differential rows for that owner from the already-withheld snapshot, preserving reviewed governance, and also re-embeds them through OpenAI if RAG_REGISTRY_CORPUS_EMBEDDING is on. (2) The site_content row: scripts/sync-site-content-corpus.ts cannot run yet, because the publication pipeline has never been initialized (site_content_sync_state initialized=false, one epoch-zero release; see #HTZPQ8), so this is blocked on the owner decision in #ZPHK2F. The seed step (1) is the only part that can run now, and it needs owner approval as a live clinical database write. PRIOR DETAIL: Data hygiene, not a live safety gap. The lithium-physiological-withdrawal-tremor record's generated body (clinical hinge, sections, immediate actions, current presentation) describes akathisia and drug-induced parkinsonism. Every read path now withholds it: loadDifferentialSnapshot covers the seed path, scopeDifferentialRecord covers the canonical read used by the three differentials API routes and differential-page-records, and differentialRowsToCorpusEntries covers the corpus projection that feeds embedding and published site content. The stored site_content and differential_records rows, seeded from the epoch-zero population frozen in supabase/migrations/20260824122000_add_site_content_release_and_outbox.sql, still contain the raw text. Nothing serves it, but any future consumer that reads a row without the projection would reintroduce the exposure, which is the reason to clean it up rather than leave it. Closing it needs an operator run of scripts/sync-site-content-corpus.ts with --write, which requires --project-ref/--confirm-project-ref sjrfecxgysukkwxsowpy, --recovery-evidence, --provider-authorization and the expected state/plan/reconciliation digests. That is a governed live clinical database write behind the provider confirmation boundary, so it is the owner's to schedule. Dry-run first and confirm the plan touches only this record. If RAG_REGISTRY_CORPUS_EMBEDDING is or was true in production, also confirm the old chunk is no longer retrievable after the republish.
